messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice perturbation search optimizing exact triple-area minimums

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is a continuously perturbed triangular lattice where each interior point of a 4×4 triangular grid is displaced by approximately 0.015–0.02 lattice units in directions that equalize its six smallest incident triangle areas, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/108 ≈ 0.00926. The perturbation eliminates the area variance inherent to the unperturbed lattice (whose minimum is 1/128 ≈ 0.00781) by redistributing area from the 38 largest triangles into the 6 smallest, and this local equalization at every interior vertex propagates to a global optimum because the minimum-area triangles are always incident to high-degree interior points rather than boundary points."}
